id: 03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C
title: 导线、导体与自耦调压器
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/03_Basic Electrical Engg Laboratory VTU Familiarization of Autotransformer Wires, C/src.py

points.K8: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
points.K10: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
points.K13: 导线等于导体加绝缘层

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台边，台上有一卷卷彩色导线和一台带旋钮的圆形调压器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with coils of colored wire and a round variable autotransformer with a big knob, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课认识导线、导体和自耦调压器。
overlay: 导线、导体与自耦调压器

shots.scene: 导体、绝缘层、导线、调压器四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a copper strand, an insulating sleeve, a coiled wire and a round voltage regulator with a knob. No people.
shots.narration: 导体、绝缘、导线、调压器。

shots.scene: 阿杰面对一桌粗细不同的彩色导线，拿起一根又放下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student faces a bench full of colored wires of different thicknesses, picking one up and putting it down, unsure.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着一桌导线，不知道该用哪根。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着圆形调压器的旋钮，一脸疑问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the knob of a round variable autotransformer with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 旁边这个带旋钮的圆盒子，又是什么？

shots.scene: 小研拿起两根导线比较粗细
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up two wires side by side to compare their thickness.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂导体、导线和调压器。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 导线和调压器，看着简单，学问不少。

shots.scene: 欣欣依次指向四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points one by one at four icons: a conductor, an insulator, a wire and an autotransformer.
shots.narration: 先讲导体和绝缘，再讲导线和调压器。

shots.scene: 金属里很多自由移动的小圆点
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a metal block with many small free-moving dots inside, arrows showing them drifting. No people.
shots.narration: 导体里的自由电子多，容易导电。

shots.scene: 左边圆点密集标绿勾，右边圆点稀少标黄色
shots.prompt_en: Two blocks side by side: left packed with free dots and a green check, right with few dots and a yellow mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电子多，电阻小；电子少，电阻大。

shots.scene: 电阻符号和倒数箭头指向电导符号
shots.prompt_en: A resistor symbol with a flip arrow pointing to a conductance symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 电导是电阻的倒数。

shots.scene: 一张空白卡片上有单位图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a unit icon. No people.
shots.narration: 单位是西门子，旧称姆欧。

shots.scene: 一卷闪亮的铜线
shots.prompt_en: A shiny coil of copper wire on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 铜线导电好，好焊接。

shots.scene: 铜线卷放在天平一侧较重，旁边有钱币图标
shots.prompt_en: A copper coil on a balance scale tipping down, next to a coin stack icon. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点是重一些、贵一些。

shots.scene: 房屋图标里的墙内布线
shots.prompt_en: A house icon with wiring routes drawn inside the walls. No people.
shots.narration: 家里布线常用铜线。

shots.scene: 一卷银灰色铝线，轻轻浮在天平上
shots.prompt_en: A coil of silver-grey aluminum wire on a balance scale tipping up, lighter. No people.
shots.narration: 铝线便宜又轻。

shots.scene: 铜和铝两根导电柱，铝的约为铜的六成
shots.prompt_en: Two conductivity bars: a copper bar full height and an aluminum bar about sixty percent as tall. No people.
shots.narration: 导电率大约是铜的六成。

shots.scene: 粗细不同的四根导线截面圆，从小到大排开
shots.prompt_en: Four wire cross-section circles of increasing size in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 截面有 1、1.5、4、6 平方毫米等规格。

shots.scene: 电流箭头穿过导线，粗电流配粗线
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows passing through wires; the thick arrow goes through the thick wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电流大，就选截面大的导线。

shots.scene: 电压表回路接细线，电流回路接粗线
shots.prompt_en: A circuit icon: thin wires leading to a voltmeter, thick wires in the main current loop with an ammeter. No people.
shots.narration: 比如测电压的回路用细线，电流回路用粗线。

shots.scene: 一卷灰色镀锌铁线
shots.prompt_en: A coil of dull grey galvanized iron wire. No people.
shots.narration: 镀锌铁线：重，导电最差。

shots.scene: 架空线和接地极两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: overhead line poles with wires, and an earth rod in the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 多用在架空线和接地。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 铜铝导线图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of copper and aluminum wires with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 铜、铝是良导体，电阻小，用来输电。
overlay: 良导体、不良导体、非导体

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 发光的灯丝和发红的电热丝
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a glowing lamp filament and a red-hot heating coil. No people.
shots.narration: 钨丝、镍铬丝电阻较大，用来发热发光。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 塑料管和玻璃瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of plastic pipes and a glass bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 塑料、玻璃几乎不导电，用来绝缘。

shots.section_title: 良导体、不良导体、非导体
shots.scene: 导线剖面：中间铜芯，外面塑料皮
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a wire: copper core in the middle, plastic sleeve outside. No people.
shots.narration: 电线把导体和绝缘体组合起来。

shots.scene: PVC、橡胶两种绝缘层样品，天然橡胶打黄色问号
shots.prompt_en: Samples of PVC insulation and vulcanized rubber insulation with green checks, and natural rubber with a yellow question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘层常用塑料和硫化橡胶。

shots.scene: 天然橡胶样品打叉
shots.prompt_en: A natural rubber sample crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 天然橡胶不宜作导线绝缘。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 一根粗实心铜芯的剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a wire with one solid copper core. No people.
shots.narration: 实心导线，一根铜芯，常用在电缆里。
overlay: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 几股铜丝绞在一起的导线，轻松弯曲
shots.prompt_en: A wire made of several copper strands twisted together, bending easily. No people.
shots.narration: 绞合导线有 1、7、19、37 股，最常用。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 绞合导线旁边一把卡尺图标
shots.prompt_en: A stranded wire next to a caliper icon. No people.
shots.narration: 整根直径大约 1.13 到 3.73 毫米，比单根软。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 很多细铜丝组成的多股线
shots.prompt_en: A wire made of many fine copper strands. No people.
shots.narration: 多股导线单丝约零点二到零点三毫米，载流更好。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 极细铜丝组成的软线，可绕成圈
shots.prompt_en: A flexible cord of very fine copper strands, coiled into a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 软线有 14、23、40 股，单丝更细。

shots.section_title: 实心线、绞合线、多股线、软线
shots.scene: 小研在空白订货单上写股数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes on a blank order form next to a coil of flexible cord.
shots.narration: 订购软线时，要说明股数。

shots.scene: 三根导线：单芯单股、单芯多股、双芯多股
shots.prompt_en: Three wire icons: single core single strand, single core multi-strand, and two-core multi-strand. No people.
shots.narration: 还有单芯单股、单芯多股、双芯多股。

shots.scene: 公式卡：电阻等于电阻率乘长度除以截面
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with a formula icon showing resistance proportional to length over area. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻跟长度成正比，跟截面成反比。

shots.scene: 大截面圆打绿勾标低电阻，小截面圆标高电阻
shots.prompt_en: Two cross-section circles: a large one labeled low resistance, a small one labeled high resistance. No people.
shots.narration: 截面大，电阻小；截面小，电阻大。

shots.scene: 长导线和短导线对比
shots.prompt_en: A long wire and a short wire side by side, the long one with a bigger resistance symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 导线越长，电阻越大。

shots.section_title: 导线等于导体加绝缘层
shots.scene: 导线剖面：铜芯 + 外皮，加号连接
shots.prompt_en: An icon equation: a copper core plus an insulating sleeve equals a finished wire. No people.
shots.narration: 导线，就是导体加绝缘层。
overlay: 导线等于导体加绝缘层

shots.section_title: 导线等于导体加绝缘层
shots.scene: 铝芯和铜芯两根导线对比
shots.prompt_en: Two wires: one with an aluminum core and a coin icon, one with a copper core and a lightning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 图省钱选铝，要导电好选铜。

shots.scene: 电流箭头只在铜芯里流动，外皮挡住
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows flowing only inside the copper core while the insulation sheath blocks them. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘层让电流只在导体里走，保证安全。

shots.scene: 小研捏着导线绝缘外皮插入接线孔
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a wire by its insulation and plugs it into a terminal.
shots.narration: 也方便用手拿取和接线。

shots.scene: 实验台上一排不同颜色、长短的连接导线
shots.prompt_en: A rack of connecting leads in different colors and lengths on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 连接导线种类多，按电路选用。

shots.scene: 圆形调压器剖面：一个线圈绕在铁心上，有滑动触点
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a round variable autotransformer: a single coil wound on a laminated iron core with a sliding contact. No people.
shots.narration: 自耦调压器只有一个绕组。

shots.scene: 转动旋钮，输出电压条平滑上升
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a knob turning and an output bar rising smoothly. No people.
shots.narration: 转动旋钮，交流电压平滑可调。

shots.scene: 单个绕组上，输入和输出共用一部分线圈
shots.prompt_en: A single winding icon where input and output share part of the same coil. No people.
shots.narration: 它和普通变压器相似，但原副边绕组相连。

shots.scene: 普通变压器两个独立线圈 vs 自耦变压器一个线圈
shots.prompt_en: Comparison icons: a two-winding transformer with two separate coils, and an autotransformer with one coil. No people.
shots.narration: 缺点是很难做到隔离。

shots.scene: 铜线卷变小、钱币图标
shots.prompt_en: A smaller copper coil icon next to a coin icon. No people.
shots.narration: 好处是省铜、经济。

shots.scene: 电压指针在设定线附近保持稳定
shots.prompt_en: A voltage gauge needle holding steady at a set line while input arrows vary. No people.
shots.narration: 它用来调整电压，或让电压保持稳定。

shots.scene: 单相调压器正面：输入插头、两个输出接线柱、旋钮和刻度
shots.prompt_en: The front of a single-phase variable autotransformer: a power cord with plug, two output terminals, a big knob and a blank dial scale. No people.
shots.narration: 单相调压器：插头接电源输入。

shots.scene: 输入端标相线和中性线两个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The input side of the autotransformer with two blank tags for line and neutral. No people.
shots.narration: 输入端分相线和中性线。

shots.scene: 旋钮转动，输出端电压随刻度变化
shots.prompt_en: The knob turning and the dial pointer moving, an arrow from the output terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 转旋钮，输出端电压随之改变。

shots.scene: 一台圆形单相调压器和一台高大的三相调压器并排
shots.prompt_en: A round single-phase variable autotransformer next to a tall three-phase one. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器有单相和三相两种。

shots.scene: 三相电路图标连到三相调压器
shots.prompt_en: A three-phase circuit icon linked to the three-phase variable autotransformer. No people.
shots.narration: 测三相功率，就要用三相调压器。

shots.scene: 单相调压器的空白铭牌，旁边是电压和电流图标
shots.prompt_en: The single-phase unit with a blank nameplate, voltage and current icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 单相的举例：零到二百七十伏，十安。

shots.scene: 三相调压器的空白铭牌，旁边是电压和电流图标
shots.prompt_en: The three-phase unit with a blank nameplate, voltage and current icons beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 三相的约四百七十伏、十安，容量各不同。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着调压器的空白名牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank name tag beside a variable autotransformer.
shots.narration: 自耦调压器，实验室常简称调压器。

shots.scene: 导体、导线、调压器三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one by one: a conductor, a wire and an autotransformer. No people.
shots.narration: 导体、绝缘、导线规格和调压器，都讲了。

shots.scene: 铜、铝、铁三种导线和截面圆
shots.prompt_en: Three coils of copper, aluminium and galvanized iron wire with cross-section circles. No people.
shots.narration: 按材料和载流量选导线，粗线电阻小。

shots.scene: 导线剖面：导体加绝缘层，旁边几种结构
shots.prompt_en: A wire cross-section of conductor plus insulation, beside solid, stranded and flexible wire icons. No people.
shots.narration: 导线是导体加绝缘，结构规格各不同。

shots.scene: 调压器旋钮和单相、三相两个图标
shots.prompt_en: A variable autotransformer knob with single-phase and three-phase icons. No people.
shots.narration: 调压器一个绕组，平滑调电压。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的导线架和调压器旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy wire rack and a variable autotransformer.
shots.narration: 认识了导线和调压器，下次见！
